notes.title: EVERSPACE 2 Summer News!
notes.content:
[p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXc-eS3kKYAdSxb-xciKwQPtD0-Ro_p05s0FHSg0JWo_LJYpiARkCFE4dpWxd3FGKOU0gxab6leS4MlFElwwkFVP3P0AXlD3vl6fXj5-TC0pqvL0cC1N5RuLyRaMYciEKT-OnEki1w?key=eJptILteet-E-0Ph-nIkaQ"][/img][/p][p][b]Greetings, pilots![/b][/p][p]It’s been a busy summer! Let’s take a look at a few things we’ve been up to as well as plans for the near future![/p][p][/p][h3][b]EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdE3z2YGfSz3JgrdjnOf287D2mygjdAqaFZAMBm5H2FTie3dylyeW5JUWC4EDiGk0YfwBBCb-MCj8Bjup9GLuRSOAMPPan-Jvyf89DtdpwsdLT55xj9YaLlqgxFGrQZMlG2zQ8Oaw?key=eJptILteet-E-0Ph-nIkaQ"][/img][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873470/EVERSPACE_2__Wrath_of_the_Ancients/"]EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients[/url], our final expansion for our current project, launched this summer to critical and community acclaim! This DLC continues the story of EVERSPACE 2, taking Adam and his band of misfits deep into Okkar controlled star systems to seek out the origins of mysterious Ancient ships attacking Human colonies.  [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ddgnk4LqCrA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]As part of the new storyline, players will set out to adventure through four new explorable star systems, each packed with multiple locations filled with new enemies, secrets, and puzzles. New side quests expand on characters and stories introduced in [i]EVERSPACE 2[/i], adding greater depth to the universe. [/p][p]A new playable Okkar spaceship, the Wraith, enables new playstyle options through powerful ability combos, increased damage opportunities, and an ultimate skill that transforms the ships’ appearance and special abilities. Pilots will be able to further power up their ships to take on the Ancient threat with legendary weapons, a new gear rarity tier, craftable components, and more. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]EVERSPACE 2: Galactic Edition[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeA-U-nui5wKIZaUJMeMBKlah5bdbt3UlDyiTgoJbdzgx_wNuQgZ5Evn4sfJ-PPdYpQsKR39wdPRrmX0em1GINma_9YasNPmP7oJwyGX9ykJXEBOsPHHOGREzyJUxFkBqDhXTB_?key=eJptILteet-E-0Ph-nIkaQ"][/img][/p][p]Space game fans have asked for a way to get everything EVERSPACE 2 all at once, and we’ve delivered! [/p][p][/p][p]Now you can get an all-in-one gameplay edition of EVERSPACE 2 on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53820/EVERSPACE_2_Galactic_Edition/"][u]Steam[/u][/url], [url="https://www.gog.com/en/game/everspace_2_galactic_edition"][u]GOG[/u][/url], [url="https://www.xbox.com/en-CA/games/store/everspace-2-galactic-edition/9NWM072LFBN3"][u]Xbox[/u][/url], and [url="https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP1562-PPSA15671_00-0598948097523306"][u]PlayStation[/u][/url] that collects [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1128920/EVERSPACE_2/"][u]EVERSPACE 2[/u][/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873460/EVERSPACE_2__Titans/"][u]EVERSPACE 2: Titans[/u][/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873470/EVERSPACE_2__Wrath_of_the_Ancients/"][u]EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients[/u][/url], and the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2911770/EVERSPACE_2__Supporter_Pack/"][u]EVERSPACE 2 Supporter Pack[/u][/url] into one discounted package. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Discover More EVERSPACE 2 Art[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdMxVfpEkyIAWvW0boXJSJ5CtQjvDnNOcGZ1CsrtlHCxTPWV0CIUICmK9fIay9stt4P5UTGZgeQAYOP72fQMa7GjWCxBHFnULgQUC6kicGrxN5O4M8A_EdIsz31txVnOcUO3oIwIQ?key=eJptILteet-E-0Ph-nIkaQ"][/img][/p][p]Alongside the launch of Wrath of the Ancients, we released a new digital-only artbook for superfans excited to take a look behind-the-scenes of development. [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690840/The_Art_of_EVERSPACE_2__Ancients__Titans/"][u]The Art of EVERSPACE 2 - Ancients & Titans[/u][/url] collects concept art, sketches, stories, and more from EVERSPACE 2: Titans and EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients, as well as content from free updates released after the launch of EVERSPACE 2. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]EVERSPACE Music To Go: A New Soundtrack and Music Streaming[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfUsM2P8OLQVvEdbuS8Zzx0ev5xEBwVKKlS5K7L07QXjpAv5TqlNqrAkwITAVU5wiv-vxYNmEuclo0cuhcmR3O1sfgt-a7oG6hC6FFPQogKi7u2HccCtYEKJjRlmvFV4Kg1Nii7pg?key=eJptILteet-E-0Ph-nIkaQ"][/img]The EVERSPACE series is known for awesome combat, amazing sci-fi environments, and a great soundtrack. [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690830/The_EVERSPACE_2_Official_Soundtrack__Expansion_Tracks/"]The EVERSPACE™ 2 Official Soundtrack - Expansion Tracks[/url][/u], collects new tracks created for post-launch content into a new album filled with music to explore the stars.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeRo4IYVp-vYI2pm0LwrnfzZyQvTGZbyxqgdrsJ3IyBmHg70nBOZKKbFtSgUKLtEETzqZQblxCLl9gsiqFfEandaXHG_yNVi3glhuwBXJJDtC6NS5Bal2IUsBfvVBuCCqR63fsvzg?key=eJptILteet-E-0Ph-nIkaQ"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’re also excited to share that music from the EVERSPACE series is coming to a streaming service near you! Tracks from the EVERSPACE games are making their way to [url="https://open.spotify.com/album/0S1rTUYoSXPVfMYFqXdKx1"][u]Spotify[/u][/url], [url="https://music.apple.com/us/album/the-everspace-2-vol-1-official-soundtrack/1832911352"][u]Apple Music[/u][/url], [url="https://music.youtube.com/playlist?list=OLAK5uy_myL8sYcYnhYz9SLlIowEWDZOdRF4erX2w"][u]YouTube Music[/u][/url], and other platforms. Check your favorite service for EVERSPACE game and DLC tracks today![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe9MU59cRIgM9xs9BGgMia6UZvAGf3DRVLkp241oo9Efiad2HouoLcscxzZx6C8Up6jp9pKhT7MyY7i-lH7aXxAK0GoCpJeuA4DERZaLloy_EVDzHJyOtPxKb6zc2eL6nKwfk2U?key=eJptILteet-E-0Ph-nIkaQ"][/img][/p][h3][b]The ROCKFISH Games Stream Goes Monthly[/b][/h3][p]As we shift focus from EVERSPACE 2 to our next project, we’re gearing down on our bi-weekly streams to a monthly cadence. As we work on \[REDACTED] ROCKFISH Games Community Manager Garry will be live the first Friday of the month to answer questions about EVERSPACE 2, share team interviews, highlight cool community screenshots and fan art, and otherwise share the latest news on [url="https://www.twitch.tv/rockfishgames"][u]Twitch[/u][/url] and [url="https://www.youtube.com/rockfishgames"][u]YouTube[/u][/url].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe_OacY_8oGkG93NhJYyMV6WA6jpv9QZnmrTYy5dPtXCWy3uDgvpPNc2sKEwJcskOcAh16GD3aQfFLXDx7b7i_pJY55fdZFCS1UyTwlQYiYLtUP7RB102BXf-ABaQHGbnG0-fSI-A?key=eJptILteet-E-0Ph-nIkaQ"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]EVERSPACE 2 Around the World[/b][/h3][p]ROCKFISH Games is headed to Japan! Space game fans at [url="https://tgs.cesa.or.jp/en"][u]Tokyo Game Show[/u][/url] can find EVERSPACE 2 and many other cool games from Germany in the German Pavilion. Watch out for booth location and more information on our socials closer to the show.[/p][p]Sharp-eyed fans may also have spotted a few ROCKFISH team members wandering around Gamescom. If you ever see us on a show floor, feel free to say hi![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdpOmE10A0-Px32TigB7EritxjQUqpX8Z3i5Mdof1x-5bobsGnKIaw-Fb93uXM6SHIYn4VV9ot6-Y4D7h-gSBzqp3g2wce2hiLAFZMbaa_8QAhPjhr4B1hZUhIulVHwOBrZNrh4GQ?key=eJptILteet-E-0Ph-nIkaQ"][/img][/p][h3][b]Live Sales[/b][/h3][p]If you haven’t completed your EVERSPACE collection, now’s the time! Find deals on everything EVERSPACE in the :[b]Steam Third Person Shooter Sale[/b][/p][list][*][p]EVERSPACE 2 - 70% off[/p][/*][*][p]EVERSPACE 2: Titans - 20% off[/p][/*][*][p]EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients - 20% off[/p][/*][*][p]EVERSPACE 2 Supporter Pack - 20% off[/p][/*][*][p]The Art of EVERSPACE™ 2 - 40% off[/p][/*][*][p]The Art of EVERSPACE™ 2 - Ancients & Titans - 20% off[/p][/*][*][p]The EVERSPACE 2 Official Soundtrack - 40% off[/p][/*][*][p]The EVERSPACE 2 Official Soundtrack - Expansion Tracks - 20% off[/p][/*][/list][p]As the team sets their sights on the future, you can support ROCKFISH Games by telling friends about your favorite EVERSPACE moments, reviewing our games and DLC, and following EVERSPACE social accounts for the latest news. It’s early days and we can’t share any details, but we’re working on something very cool that we can’t wait to talk about when we can. [/p][p]See you in the stars,[/p][p]Lee and the ROCKFISH Games team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: EVERSPACE 2 Patch 1.4.48188
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/45382cf3f3b3743283a5054745dcbdd14fa4979c.png"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, pilots!
[/p][p]It’s time for one last patch to EVERSPACE 2 and [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873470/EVERSPACE_2__Wrath_of_the_Ancients/"][u]Wrath of the Ancients[/u][/url]! The team has put together fixes for bugs shared by the community, as well as a few small tweaks. 
[/p][p]As we’ve come to the close of the EVERSPACE 2 project, we will be disabling Crowdin. We’re very happy with the state of the various translations and would thank every community member who has ever submitted a translation bug or made a localization suggestion. You’ve all helped improve the experience for other players worldwide! 
[/p][p]While we don’t plan on releasing another patch, we are continuing to keep an eye out for issues reported by players in the[url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1128920/discussions/6/?snr=1_2108_9__2107"] [u]Steam Community Hub[/u][/url] and the ROCKFISH Games[url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2Frockfishgames"] [u]Discord[/u][/url]. Please continue to share issues in these places.  
[/p][p]Find the full list of tweaks and bugfixes added in today’s update below.[/p][p][b]Changelog: 1.4.48188 [/b][/p][p][b]Tweaks[/b][/p][list][*][p]\[WOTA] Tweaked that Okkar gas tanks no longer turn Okkar units hostile when destroyed[/p][/*][*][p]\[Windows] Updated DLSS plugin version to 4.0.2[/p][/*][*][p]Integrated community suggestions for translation improvements from Crowdin and our community testers[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bugfixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a potential crash when using Sentinel ULT with no primary weapons equipped[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare crash when changing difficulty in some locations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed unlocked blueprints count mismatch in data/collectibles screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed that the "Play It Safe" player perk's reactive armor condition was capped to 90% max damage reduction instead of 100%[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed that player ship banking was broken after skipping dock or undock animation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the overly bright appearance of the "Zethes Research Station" in "Khione"[/p][/*][*][p]UI: Fixed that recently bought item indicator was not removed when sending item straight to homebase after purchase[/p][/*][*][p]\[WOTA] Fixed crash when using Entropy Anchor during Sentinel ULT[/p][/*][*][p]\[WOTA] Fixed that the Golden Ace’s additional ship hangar slot was removed when completing a hangar size perk after receiving the Golden Ace[/p][/*][*][p]\[WOTA] Fixed wrong probability for radiant Reliquary drops at the end of Ancient Altar events[/p][/*][*][p]\[WOTA] Replaced location save after Ancient Altar event with autosave[/p][/*][*][p]\[WOTA] Fixed that ancient altar events could get stuck if hostile freighter spawned and jumped out during the fight[/p][/*][*][p]\[WOTA] Fixed that Reinforced Frame catalyst would only double the base hull hitpoints, not the total hull hitpoints[/p][/*][*][p]\[WOTA] Fixed that Ambient Collector and Reserve Power catalysts would not affect the Bomber's secondary weapon energy[/p][/*][*][p]\[WOTA] Fixed that it was possible for player drones to spawn while using a remote drone to scout a location in the Ushak system and during a certain event of the “The Peace of the Ancients” mission[/p][/*][*][p]\[WOTA] Fixed random rotation for Okkar Frigate boss in rifts[/p][/*][*][p]\[WOTA] Fixed that Reliquaries dropped by Ancient Altars were the same when saving and loading between upgrade events[/p][/*][*][p]\[WOTA] Fixed that Okkar Frigate Rift boss could spawn inside asteroid fields[/p][/*][*][p]\[WOTA] Fixed missing dialogues in Swarmer Distress Call events[/p][/*][*][p]\[WOTA] Fixed that Okkar Prime Interceptor damage and hitpoints were not correctly initialized[/p][/*][*][p]\[WOTA] Fixed that Okkar Frigate weak spots were sometimes not damageable with Flak Cannons or secondaries[/p][/*][*][p]\[WOTA] Fixed a rare case in which the “Wrath of the Ancients” mission did not continue after undocking from a station before a dialogue was triggered[/p][/*][/list][p]We hope you’re all having fun with EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients! Stay tuned for more team interviews, Q&A sessions, and game news here, on our social channels, and streams!
[/p][p]Lee and your ROCKFISH Games team[/p]

notes.title: EVERSPACE 2 Patch 1.4.48111
notes.content:
Greetings, pilots!

We hope you had an exciting weekend adventuring in Okkar star systems in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873470/EVERSPACE_2__Wrath_of_the_Ancients/]Wrath of the Ancients[/url]! 

The team has put together another patch with fixes for bugs found by QA and the community, as well as a few small tweaks to improve the overall experience. We also took this opportunity to clean up a few small bugs found in the Titans DLC. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/06af3a52e15afe4e5c2c1739ce6443340683b7d1.png[/img]

As mentioned in previous posts, thank you to the community members who took the time to report issues and follow up with more information. The details shared make it much easier for the team to find and fix bugs we’ve missed.

We’re continuing to keep an eye out for issues reported by players in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1128920/discussions/6/?snr=1_2108_9__2107]Steam Community Hub[/url] and the ROCKFISH Games [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2Frockfishgames]Discord[/url]. While we can’t promise there will be another patch in the immediate future, we’ll be assessing a need for future updates based on the quantity and severity of issues found. 

Read on for the full list of tweaks and bug fixes added in today’s update.

[b]Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*] Import custom styles from other ships is available on all stations now (not just at homebase)
[*] [WOTA] Reduced Ancient Altar Lunacy range from 400 - 1600 to 300 - 1000
[*] [WOTA] Added confirmation pop-up for Ancient Altar events if the player’s ship is ill-equipped for the challenge
[*] [WOTA] Highlight Viridium core during "Wrath of the Ancients" boss fight
[*] [WOTA] Ghost's ship can now also be stopped with the “Incapacitate” condition in “A Different Ending”
[*] [WOTA] Provided more guidance on how to start “Far and Beyond” side mission via mission indicators
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed that damage reduction was not capped at 90%
[*] Fixed "Break open the hardened ore patch" location challenge at “Grady and Brunt Refinery” potentially not counting towards location completion percentage
[*] Fixed that certain structures in the “Lost Cargo” job category blocked entry points or holes, making the job unfinishable
[*] UI: Fixed some cases where mining attributes were accidentally filtered out from the list of lockables when re-rolling
[*] UI: Fixed that “amount selection” radial progress bar color was wrong (blue)
[*] UI: Fixed minor navigation inconsistency in modal item modification screen
[*] UI: Fixed a rare issue that could render an empty slot statcard over the “Ship Stats” tooltip after changing ships
[*] UI: Fixed minor layout issues of some modal screens when using 16:10 aspect ratio
[*] UI: Fixed a graphical glitch affecting the mission intro/outro banner background blur
[*] [WOTA] Fixed that it was possible to leave during certain parts of the side mission "The Countdown" which lead to some Trinychs attacking in other locations
[*] [WOTA] Fixed a problem in which "The Countdown" mission did not continue properly after having left the mission location at a bad time
[*] [WOTA] Fixed that Ancient Rifts were aborted although "Second Chance" mode of Entropy Anchor was activated before hull hitpoints reached zero
[*] [WOTA] Fixed that Munition Motor booster was increasing weapon spread while boosting instead of decreasing it
[*] [WOTA] Fixed an issue that caused HIVE to keep on commenting during mission "Ukkram"
[*] [WOTA] Fixed a subtitle to voice-line mismatch in the mission "A Different Ending"
[*] [WOTA] Fixed that "Warden's Embrace" mine launcher could be fired with no ammo left
[*] [WOTA] Fixed that it was possible to use a portable conductor for a wrong puzzle, resulting in a puzzle blocker in “Shakut Waystations”
[*] [WOTA] Fixed that Reinforced Frame catalyst would give you unlimited consumables
[*] [WOTA] Fixed that a Hexaspatial catalyst installed on top of a Chaos catalyst would re-roll the shield's stats
[*] [WOTA] Fixed that Safety Delimiter catalyst would damage weapons that have the "Cannot be damaged" attribute
[*] [WOTA] UI: Fixed that Ushak codex entry was unlocked when entering Rhak Homeworlds and vice versa
[*] [TITANS] Fixed that it was possible for Leviathan or Dreadnought alert dialogues to play during cutscenes
[*] [TITANS] Fixed NPC character portraits during Dreadnought missions
[*] [TITANS] Fixed black screen that occurred when attempting to enter a 'Leviathan Sighting' location by automatically disabling the auto-pilot if the event has already expired
[/list]
It will be a while until we can share about what comes next. For now, thank you to all you fantastic space game fans who have supported us during EVERSPACE 2’s journey. 

Lee and your ROCKFISH Games team

notes.title: EVERSPACE 2 Patch 1.4.48035
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/4bea1f7063d5ff570aee2bc940111211b28742f6.jpg[/img]

Greetings, pilots!

It’s fantastic seeing so many of you enjoying [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873470/EVERSPACE_2__Wrath_of_the_Ancients/]EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients![/url] We can’t believe that some of you have already completed 4000 lunacy rifts! 

We’ve got a small patch for all you pilots planning to play this weekend. This patch is focused on fixing a number of bugs early Wrath of the Ancients players have encountered. 

Read on for a full list of changes. 

[b]1.4.48035 Wrath of the Ancients Hotfix[/b]

[b]Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*] UI: No longer auto-enable DLSS-RR when enabling Lumen while DLSS is active
[*] UI: Integrated community suggestions for translation improvements from [url=https://crowdin.com/project/everspace2]Crowdin[/url] and our community testers
[*] [WOTA] Reduced Destabilizer Mines damage
[*] [WOTA] During "The Peace of the Ancients”, the guiding light will now stop if the distance to the player becomes too large
[*] [WOTA] Disabled auto-aiming for bigger Ancient Swarmer units
[*] [WOTA] Improved Okkar station energy VFX
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed view distance of Redemption 2-set bonus particle effect
[*] Fixed that re-rolling attributes after locking could cause a crash in some rare cases
[*] Fixed ARC9000 showing lightning arcs to player drones
[*] Fixed spawned debris not being removed after the “Ghost Fleet” boss fight
[*] Fixed that damage and overheat conditions would sometimes get removed prematurely
[*] Fixed that sounds remained muffled when loading a different save game while underwater
[*] Fixed that blueprints would still drop as loot despite having all of them unlocked
[*] Fixed that energy cores were too difficult to pull out from weaponized mining turrets
[*] Fixed that Outlaws were attacking stations in Union Bridge and Ceto Transit Gate although they were not supposed to
[*] Fixed a missing CVar setting for DLSS-RR
[*] UI: Fixed wrong amount of maximum blueprints to be found in data/collectibles stats screen
[*] UI: Fixed that world codex quick jump icon “new” indicators were not updated after “mark-all-as-read” action
[*] UI: Fixed that data tab fade-in-out animations could get stuck in some rare cases
[*] UI: Fixed that world codex background image would initially disappear when entering multiple times
[*] UI: Fixed that you needed to hit the back button twice to close modal equipment crafting menu when using gamepad
[*] UI: Fixed several smaller layout issues of item statcard in space
[*] [WOTA] Fixed an issue which caused Ghost's ship to vanish and block the mission due to using the Spatial Bypass in Prescott Starbase during "A Different Ending"
[*] [WOTA] Fixed that all dockables could be disabled during mission "A Different Ending"
[*] [WOTA] Fixed a conflict between "Close Encounters" and "Tipping the Scales" that lead to being unable to leave Ceto Transit Gate in time and dying due to Kaion radiation if both missions were active
[*] [WOTA] Fixed a case in which “Far and Beyond” and “In Imroth’s Name” side missions failed to start if a manual save was created at an inconvenient time
[*] [WOTA] Fixed an issue which could prevent the mission “Parasite III” at Navia Orbit from progressing correctly
[*] [WOTA] Fixed "The Wraith" side mission not completing properly under certain conditions
[*] [WOTA] Fixed an edge case that could lead to a post-processing effect getting stuck during "The Peace of the Ancients”
[*] [WOTA] Fixed that a part of the conductor puzzle, the Ancient Jar, was not spawned in “Khaït Heliosphere”
[*] [WOTA] Fixed that there was no supralight music in Aethon system during parts of “A Different Ending”
[*] [WOTA] Fixed that you could re-enter the closed portals from the chase in the “Far and Beyond” mission after loading a checkpoint
[*] [WOTA] Fixed an issue where the waypoints in the mission "Relic Hunt" were not updating correctly
[*] [WOTA] Fixed an issue where multiple copies of an NPC ship were present in the side mission "In Imroth's Name"
[*] [WOTA] Fixed an issue where Okkar units would stay hostile when re-entering a location, even though the wanted state had expired
[*] [WOTA] Fixed that the large Ancient Swarmer would mix attack patterns if you interrupted its beam laser attack by flying behind it
[*] [WOTA] Fixed that Brood Mine swarms interfere with Trinych and Cave Crawler movement
[*] [WOTA] Fixed that Hexaspatial Catalyst could not be installed on equipped shield that has the Peripheral Catalyst installed while legendary equipment limit is reached
[*] [WOTA] Fixed that ascendant catalysts did not count towards the Ascendancy set bonus when applied to a shield that had the Hexaspatial catalyst installed
[*] [WOTA] Fixed Ancient Swarmer boss being revivable by the “Wrath of the Fallen” legendary
[*] [WOTA] Fixed that active wingmen would still try to fly in formation with player while being docked
[*] [WOTA] Fixed that engine trails of wings would remain after Okkar Prime Split Fighter ejected its wings
[*] [WOTA] Fixed that sometimes there were too few mines around Okkar ships in distress calls of type “mine field”
[*] [WOTA] Fixed missing location challenge text for “Aethon Freight Depot” on the map
[*] [WOTA] Fixed missing location challenge text for “Towers of Herat” on the map
[*] [WOTA] Fixed missing HUD marker text for a secret at “Portal Hub” location
[*] [WOTA] Fixed that there were visible tunnel gaps in “Trial of the Minds”
[*] [WOTA] Fixed that the sound of wormholes opening during a sequence of “The Old Man and the Universe” side mission would play even though sequence was skipped
[*] [WOTA] Fixed a tunnel gap in “Portal Hub”
[*] [WOTA] Fixed an issue where some of the bigger Okkar stations would play the wrong "pulsing" sound
[*] [WOTA] Fixed that damage smoke of the G&B freighter that jumps away from G&B Refinery during "Close Encounters" remained in location
[*] [WOTA] Re-inserted a German voice line
[*] [WOTA] UI: Fixed that Golden Ace location indicator was missing when pointing at the location in Supralight

notes.title: EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients Now Available | Update 1.4.47918 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/e7545b467126f670f55e5ac1d55f0c01d227702c.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Pilots!

EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients is now live on PC and consoles! It’s time to take flight through an all-new adventure set after the events of EVERSPACE 2, that leads pilots deep into star systems controlled by the Okkar. As Adam and his band of misfits seek the origins of mysterious Ancient ships attacking Human colonies, truths of the Okkar race come to light. Apart from that, you may also reunite with an old friend, leading into the Aethon System. 

[previewyoutube=ddgnk4LqCrA;full][/previewyoutube]
As part of the new storyline, players adventure through four new explorable star systems, each packed with multiple locations filled with new enemies, secrets, and new types of puzzles. New side quests expand on characters and stories introduced in EVERSPACE 2, adding greater depth to the universe. All-in-all, this new expansion adds more than ten hours of new post-game and side quest storylines to the base game. 

Wrath of the Ancients adds a new playable Okkar spaceship, the Wraith, which enables new playstyle options through powerful ability combos, increased damage opportunities, and an ultimate skill that transforms the ships’ appearance and special abilities. Pilots will be able to further power up their ships to take on the Ancient threat with legendary weapons, a new gear rarity tier, craftable components, and more. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1128920/view/521959859806012200?l=english]Find out more in our Deep Dive blog.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/d9f796375d292d5a1bfb0ed6bec552697775f093.png[/img]
All EVERSPACE 2 owners should see a new base game update available to download. This update fixes many community reported issues and adds optimizations that should improve experiences for many players, especially those on Xbox Series S. Most notably, update 1.4.47918 brings some very cool quality-of-life features that fans have been asking for:
[list]
[*] Expanded ship hangar—one more ship slot 
[*] Ship-to-ship gear transfer at Homebase
- Equipment compare and swapping across player ships
- Fast one-click cargo transfer (PC-only)
[*] Gear reroll stat / trait locking
[*] We’ve removed the gear level up cap—now pilots can upgrade favorite weapons and gear up to the player’s current level, but each upgrade has an increased cost
[*] Added mark-as-favorite action for all non-stackable items to protect favorites from (mass-) dismantling and selling operations
[*] Mark-all-items action and hotkey (Ctrl+A) / Gamepad: Action available on empty slots within Expand view
[*] Dedicated sorting type for set-items
[*] Direct ship selection with mouse (PC only)
[*] World codex quick jump-to-category feature including dedicated category for ship classes
[*] Added ship customization option to import styles from other ships
[*] Ship customization action to manually toggle effects / night-mode in every submenu
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/632e5186a4657a4318b5e54b2a6f30fb3c5bbd14.png[/img]
These features come alongside dozens of changes and improvements. Skip to the bottom of this post for a full list of bug fixes, tweaks, and quality-of-life features introduced in this new update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/296942569a6c19beeee47452ca1632c7abb30e50.jpg[/img]
Sci-fi concept art fans, today is your lucky day! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690840/The_Art_of_EVERSPACE_2__Ancients__Titans]The Art of EVERSPACE 2 - Ancients & Titans[/url] is now available! This digital-only artbook contains 152 pages of concept art, sketches, character portraits, and developer stories created during the development of EVERSPACE 2: Titans and EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients. Fair warning, this digital book is FULL of spoilers for anyone who hasn’t yet completed both expansions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/0da3a3b36fad5a060caad09aea6efbe19a99c037.jpg[/img]
Today, we are also releasing a new soundtrack DLC! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690830/The_EVERSPACE_2_Official_Soundtrack__Expansion_Tracks]The EVERSPACE 2 Official Soundtrack - Expansion Tracks[/url] collects twenty-five new tracks from Titans and Wrath of the Ancients into a new collaboration album combining the talents of longtime EVERSPACE series Composer and Sound Director Gero Goerlich and Senior Sound Designer Lukas Deuschel! This album celebrates the best music created for EVERSPACE 2 DLCs and former free content updates.

With the addition of these three new DLCs, we’re changing up our bundles on Steam. A new Complete Edition allows new space fans to get everything EVERSPACE 2 in one. The Galactic Edition contains the base game and all gameplay DLC. Base game owners who haven’t purchased any DLC can buy a bundle to get all gameplay DLC in one package. Finally, we’ve put together a collect the set bundle for our artbooks and soundtracks. These content packages are replacing older bundles and offer better deals to players looking to get as much EVERSPACE 2 content as they can in one go.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/583544a21e73140c1ce8acf90c4c3317b6a3d259.png[/img]
Wrath of the Ancients is the last piece of gameplay DLC coming to EVERSPACE 2. The team has been working on this project for nearly eight years now and we’re excited to get a start on our next adventure. You all will likely see another update or two with bug fixes, tweaks, and minor quality-of-life features—please keep reporting bugs in our Discord and the EVERSPACE 2 Steam community hub! We can’t say anything about what we’re dreaming up right now, but there are cool things coming on the distant horizon. Stay tuned!

notes.title: EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients - Let’s Talk Pricing
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/b1cd6e8be8c43583c43b8723b2e7f924ecce1454.jpg[/img]
Greetings, Pilots!

Let’s talk about everyone’s favorite subject, pricing!

With events happening in the world, it seems like everything is getting more expensive and there’s a lot of uncertainty in general. You feel it, we feel it, and all those marketing emails we’ve all been hammered with talking about prices going up certainly don’t help. 

Let’s change that! 

In our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1128920/view/524213474678538448]EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients release date reveal post[/url], we shared our upcoming expansion was going to be priced at $29.99. Recently, the team got together to have a chat to reassess, and we’ve decided to lower the price of EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients to [b]$24.99 / €24.99 / £19.99 / ¥2970[/b] (other regional pricing will be in line with Steam guidelines). 

With this in mind, we have also recently lowered the price of EVERSPACE 2: Titans from $14.99 USD to $11.99 USD, giving all those space pilots who haven’t yet played it more bang for fewer bucks. 

Now before anyone gets the wrong idea, no content has been cut—we’re in the middle of our final polish and bug fixing phase ahead of release. The four star systems in Wrath of the Ancients are going to be packed full of new story, side quests, enemies, gear, music, and, of course, you’ll be getting your hands on the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WHtc_TI6yjY]new playable Wraith ship[/url].

As an independent studio, we are lucky to be in a position to be able to do this based on the support of an amazing community. If you were genuinely looking forward to giving us that little bit extra, thank you! We will have a new artbook and soundtrack gathering together content from our DLCs available when Wrath of the Ancients launches that you can put that money towards instead.

If that fiver means more ramen in your pantry, we get and respect that. Do your part by spreading the word about EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients and give us a positive review if you like what you’ve played. It helps! 

We can’t wait to share EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients with you all on [b]May 12[/b]. 

Lee and your ROCKFISH Games team

notes.title: New Ship - Wraith Deep Dive
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/6459c298c32d9003bf59560dae776d161c7f9051.jpg[/img]
Greetings, Pilots!

Our upcoming expansion, EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients, is bringing all kinds of awesome space adventure to the table, but the number one thing we know many of you want is the chance to fly a new spacecraft! Buckle up, because today’s blog and video featuring our Community Manager, Garry, will be showing off a cool new ship coming later this year. Get ready for the Wraith!

[previewyoutube=WHtc_TI6yjY;full][/previewyoutube]
While progressing through the Wrath of the Ancients main storyline, Adam will be able to acquire the Wraith, an Okkar armed blockade runner, modified for a human pilot which utilizes cutting-edge technology pushing beyond Okkar standards from [REDACTED BECAUSE OF SPOILERS]. Don’t expect to find it at your local ship dealer, the Wraith is a one-of-a-kind spacecraft that will be found in one location in the expansion. 

First off, let’s talk about the look of the ship. The Wraith is an Okkar-made fighter, and it looks like it—our design team wanted to bring players something new that also ties into the Okkar culture which is at the heart of the new DLC. Coloring can be changed based on the various highlights collected for other ships. The cybernetic glow option found in our Supporter Pack will also work with this ship. As this is a unique spacecraft, it’s not possible to find modules to modify the shape of its appearance. Also, the ship's passives are predetermined and not subject to RNG like the other ships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/b49ac69bb55919a419a3edd87ceff8ff76bacf94.png[/img]
We think players are going to love what the Wraith brings to the fight. This ship is a medium/heavy fighter that behaves unlike many of the other spacecraft available in EVERSPACE 2. This is a high-risk, high reward fighter for players who like blending a wide range of abilities with up close and personal combat. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/ddbaf6c5722c6bb3532b562fa0d6cdc582e2c1ef.jpg[/img]
The Wraith’s ULT and abilities are designed to introduce a unique playstyle for EVERSPACE 2 pilots. "Spectral Form" transforms the Wraith into a semi-corporeal state which causes hull to decay at an increasing rate which acts as a timer. The less hull you have, the more damage the Wraith will unleash. When your hull reaches zero, Spectral Form ends and your ship is restored to full hull. In addition to a significant damage boost, being in Spectral Form replaces devices with new special abilities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/21aea7e3ee5531b09b6762115d8ee3ad79f6b593.png[/img]
Special "Quantum Covenant": Killing enemies leaves Echo Fragments floating in place. Collecting a fragment grants a stack of “Ethereal Resonance”, each dealing damage per second to all nearby enemies while increasing your speed. Damage is doubled for your locked target.

Siphon Pulse - Consume all “Ethereal Resonance” stacks and instantly deal the remaining damage to all affected enemies, repairing your hull for a percentage of the damage dealt.

Spectral Shift - Teleport forward, passing through smaller enemies, and damage all targets in a 100m radius around the path. Collects all Echo Fragments along the way.

Vanish - Turn invisible and suspend the hull decay for a short time. Duration increases when collecting Echo Fragments.

Resurgence - Collect all available Echo Fragments and revive them to fight for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/77ff98f99b5beb5a8eead725b0ba1d3dcfe3a251.jpg[/img]
Finally, we know some space pilots like to collect favorite versions of each ship class—when Wrath of the Ancients launches, we’ll be releasing an update to the base game which will include many features and fixes, including an additional hanger slot. 

See you among the stars!

Lee and your ROCKFISH Games team

notes.title: EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients Star Systems and Locations
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/739a36c32e2a471dbd557ba15dd1763fea369bd9.png[/img]

Greetings, Pilots!

Beyond the borders of Colonial space lay mysterious dangers, alien wormholes, extreme radiation, battlefield debris, ancient ruins, and other exciting challenges for space pilots willing to venture deep into uncharted territory.

Let’s take a look at some of the new locations you’ll be exploring in EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients.

[previewyoutube=Nnsd24lIOzI;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Is that new music? Why yes, it is![/i]

Let’s go a little deeper.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/9a7053ab71d26091b1f01823e1df5581d9360d21.png[/img]

[h3][b]Aethon[/b][/h3]

For years, EVERSPACE pilots have been asking when they’ll be able to explore this star system in full. The answer is soon™. 

Aethon is a dangerous system filled with radiation fields and warship hulks drifting in the dark. Scrappers seeking a payday off this wreckage put their lives on the line against Outlaw bandits and hazards left from the Colonial War.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/2108203a2265bedef2c52eb1c16b166dc74815ac.png[/img]

Humankind no longer maintains any organized presence here. The system's aging, unstable red star casts a hellish light over the wreckage of research stations and old Freelancer bases—even before the war, previous attempts to establish settlements were difficult due to the dangerous environment. Years under hostile conditions have clawed away at structures, but they may still hold some secrets. 
The events that point Adam towards this system involve an old friend. You’ll have to wait to find out more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/a470341b115add2adeeb0f3ad0b4023097c52c47.png[/img]

[h3][b]Khaït Dominion[/b][/h3]

The closest Okkar rim system to the Colonial border is also one of the most sacred to the Okkar. Years ago, when Humankind expansion encroached into this system, the Okkar retaliated in force.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/6eaaad5d6a197091bf83109d2829c3b8952d80fd.png[/img]

Planets, once desert-haven cradles to the Okkar civilization, are now loosely populated by few, dotted with ancient structures and mysterious ruins. Historical records say this system was a home to the Ancients as they nurtured the Okkar into a starfaring species, but their monuments are now dormant tombstones. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/2f1c4dc4c802eeacc1c7800c25bdd6695d2c5593.png[/img]

Strange as it sounds, a natural wormhole bridges this system with the Khaït Nebula. Due to this anomaly, possibly connected to the Ancients, the fabric between dimensions is especially thin here, leading to the growth of Viridium in large fields. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/987070c5cc21551ce99ee4ca27b8013c2d8aadcb.png[/img]

[h3][b]Rhak Homeworlds[/b][/h3]

This system is the beating heart of this sector of modern Okkar civilization. Much of their population lives on gigantic orbital stations and sprawling mega-structures covering the planets below them. The advanced technology of the Okkar can clearly be seen in these structures and the gigantic wormhole generator arrays that lead to Ushak Sanctuary and the Khaït Dominion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/82c96ca7a493ab65fe0fa8116bd91b5dbbd633a7.png[/img]

Though it has been more than a decade since the end of the war, some structures still bear the scars of Human attacks—wreck fields with the remains of Okkar and Colonial warships have yet to be cleared due to their massive scale. The hardline anti-Human faction, Okkar Prime, point to these remnants of conflict as they push to reclaim territory they feel had been wrongly ceded to the colonists. 

This system is also home to two stars: one white, the other yellow. Billions of years ago, the second ejected its corona as plasma when it became a white dwarf, leaving ghostly plasma fields that exist to this day. Human astronomers are unsure how planets in the system survived this event, though the influence of the Ancients may be the cause. Even now, the system remains rich in the resources that corporations such as G&B covet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/f9da37809073476bdd0d37ac006564c044c18522.png[/img]

[h3][b]????????????????????[/b][/h3]

Be prepared when venturing into the "Forbidden System". This most ancient of the Okkar worlds is a religious center holy to the Okkar, home to few—even Outlaws and Redeemers know to keep well away. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/6f700097fba10f3ac80bf9216a7d9873e0d18b79.png[/img]

The welcome presence of a non-Okkar is unprecedented. How will you be visiting this system? Will you be welcome at all? 

If you haven’t already, make sure to watch our most [url=https://youtu.be/DREICR4c6y8]recent devstream[/url] as our Community Manager, Garry, tours through seven different locations that will be explorable in Wrath of the Ancients. When the expansion releases later this year, you’ll be able to play through these and more. 

Stay tuned for more news, our next update on these channels will be a deep dive into our new ship, The Wraith. 

Lee and your ROCKFISH Games team

notes.title: EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients Announced!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/17800a500a85b90271a3c4bd575deaf00fae10a0.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Pilots!

Today, we announce [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873470]EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients[/url], a massive expansion that adds a sprawling post-game story, multiple star systems, extensive side quests, new player ship, and more. Before diving into what’s to come, check out our announcement trailer.

[previewyoutube=jij3a23hx3E;full][/previewyoutube]

Attacks on Colonial settlements by weapons of the Ancients spark conflict in Cluster 34 once again. As these take place, a rising Okkar faction argues that if the Ancients reject Humankind, so should their people. With the uneasy peace threatened, Adam and crew will venture into the Okkar Homeworlds to discover the truth behind the threat before war reignites the DMZ.

We chose Tareen, voiced by the amazing June Yoon, as the character to voice this announcement trailer as Wrath of the Ancients explores the story of the Okkar and the aftermath of the war that tore Cluster 34 apart. Throughout their history, the Okkar have been closely tied to the Ancients—a species Ancients lifted to the stars, who now live among the ruins of those who came before. The story ahead will answer many questions and possibly create new ones for the future. 

[previewyoutube=P2HY4RmXstg;full]EVERSPACE 2 | Expansion Teaser[/previewyoutube]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/live/Lk20ge438AA?si=-_5mV63DkOHoBfYT]In our last stream of 2024[/url], we teased Aethon, a star system many of you space pilots have been asking to visit. This system is filled with time-ravaged wrecks, shattered Colonial weapons, and leftover remnants from the war, a perfect place for an enterprising scavenger to explore. The team is busy packing new locations full of secrets, new puzzle types, and rewards for inquisitive players.

Aethon is only a small part of EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients. We’ll be journeying to several of the stars of the Okkar civilization and visiting many new areas in orbit, deep space, and on planets. All you lore hounds should get ready, as our writing team has been creating very cool storylines that explore these alien regions of space. Pilots will have much to discover between these new locations and expanded existing star systems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/8073bca1b11c081a94f9397b263242fae8c1bdc7.png[/img]

In addition to the new post-game storyline, pilots can seek out new side quests that build on events of the base game. These will be spread not only in new systems, but also in ones you’ve visited already. Many stories are left to be told in the DMZ—adventures for the brave and fearsome enemies who remain in the shadows. There’s a hint to one somewhere in this blog. Let’s see if any of you guess what it is.  

For our more combat-focused fans, soon you’ll be able to take flight in the Okkar Wraith ship against a variety of challenging new enemies. This new ship sports a variety of powerful new abilities that reward players who put it all on the line in close combat. You’ll be able to power up any ship you choose to fly with new weapons and gear, including a new upgradable Okkar equipment type, which we’ll share more about in future blog posts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/76cfbd7837e93338c2e343b4c7993ba0b4ac05b9.png[/img]

EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients comes to Steam, GOG, Xbox, and PlayStation late Spring. We’ll have more to share about the new star systems, enemies, gear, and characters here and on our social channels in the months ahead. Make sure to follow us on [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/ROCKFISHGames/]YouTube[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/everspace.game/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/everspace.game]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@everspace_game]Tik Tok[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/everspace_game]X[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/everspace_game/?hl=en]Instagram[/url] for sneak peeks. Stay tuned!

Soon™, the Ancients will awaken! 

Lee and your ROCKFISH Games team

notes.title: Wrapping Up 2024 | Expansion Tease
notes.content:
Greetings pilots! 

As 2024 comes to a close, the ROCKFISH team is headed out for the winter break. Our end of year gift to the community is a little peek at what we've been working on plus some killer discounts on EVERSPACE base games and DLC! Skip down to the end of the post to check out the teaser, otherwise read on for our recap of the year!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/51b81ea52efffba931cc4b13a1c02d5edeaaec85.png[/img]
We began 2024 with looks at content coming in the free [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1128920/view/4187860062713350990][i]Incursions update[/i][/url] as well as insights into the Unreal Engine 5 migration we released along the same time. Incursions brought a new horde mode event, legendary gear, and reliquaries, as well as even greater endgame challenges. A tremendous amount of work went into this update, giving players more to do and our developers tools to create expansion content for EVERSPACE 2. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/dd790965e1d332a77689b1cac69123efb7f45912.jpg[/img]
We also celebrated the 10 year anniversary of ROCKFISH Games! Our CEO and Creative Director [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FhfuEz3UeVw]sat down to chat[/url] about their experiences working together since the studio was started.  We’re a small team and many of our developers have been working together for years, even previous to the founding of the studio. Here’s to another decade of space games!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/a537d2acf8c6628ffacbdab8745724c505675ec2.jpg[/img]
Shortly before the release of the Incursions update, EVERSPACE 2 was awarded Best German Game at the 2024 Deutschen Computerspielpreis (German Computer Game Awards)!
We couldn’t be more proud as this is Germany’s biggest game developer event. Winning this was recognition for the incredible work done during the team’s six year journey on EVERSPACE 2 and gave us renewed motivation to continue crafting quality space games on PC and consoles!

[previewyoutube=PEWg3WQlVco;full][/previewyoutube]
Along with Incursions came many engine changes under the hood that brought improvements and a few challenges that have largely been solved. We released a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1128920/announcements/detail/3891737610851258992]fun blog[/url] showing many of the more amusing visual bugs that popped up early in the project. If you’re curious about some of the hurdles we faced, check out this [url=https://www.unrealengine.com/en-US/tech-blog/everspace-2-sets-a-course-for-the-future-through-unreal-engine-5]article on the Unreal Developer Blog[/url] outlining some of the work the RFG team tackled in the update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/3216874235e3052da1771bb4b2776f3764c28d9e.png[/img]

Alongside the Incursions update, we also released the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2911770/EVERSPACE_2__Supporter_Pack/]EVERSPACE 2: Supporter Pack[/url]. The community of space fans had been asking how they could support ROCKFISH while we worked on future content, and this was our answer. The team packed this full of ship skins and customization features, including a cool cybernetic glow look inspired by a bug shown in our Unreal Engine migration bug blog, this optional cosmetic DLC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/1fee739a15e8dc512623d16971d9a24fef520017.jpg[/img]
We also released a physical print edition of The Art of EVERSPACE 2. Originally, this book was supposed to be a much smaller volume, but with all the amazing concept art created for the game, we got away from ourselves. This fantastic 280+ artbook is still in stock on [url=https://www.amazon.com/Art-EVERSPACE-ROCKFISH-Games-GmbH/dp/3000766588]Amazon[/url] and makes a great gift for space and sci-fi fans *hint hint*. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/458a6df02c464290d0448ee314d3185ea5a217df.png[/img]
Alienware has supported us at events during our launch journey, so we developed a special free [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2915570/EVERSPACE_2__Alienware_Ship_Skin/]Alienware Ship Skin[/url] as a way to say thanks to their team and the PC space game community. The ship skin is still free on Steam! Grab it today to give your ships a sleek white, black, and green look. 

[previewyoutube=MoOaS6oqMGY;full][/previewyoutube]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873460/EVERSPACE_2__Titans/]EVERSPACE 2: Titans[/url] is our first gameplay DLC for EVERSPACE 2 and amongst the team, we’re calling it our smaller one! Teased on the ROCKFISH Games stream shortly before Gamescom, Titans brings two exciting mini-adventures with replayable encounters and a whole armory of new weapons and gear to the table. These new repeatable experiences brought plenty for space fans to do while we focused on more story-based adventures and locations for our upcoming expansion.

[previewyoutube=gpCUqct39po;full][/previewyoutube]
As part of the Titans reveal, our Community Manager, Garry voiced a fantastic deep dive into the inner flora and fauna of the Leviathan. Perhaps we should get him in the V/O booth as a character someday! Like the idea? Let us know in the comments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/c83440c17267a37bf04b28e1919c689de79f1fde.jpg[/img]
As a German studio, Gamescom is our home show and the Indie Arena Booth is one of the best places to see upcoming games at the event—There’s no better place to see a sheer amount of creativity per square meter in the whole show! We surprised space fans at the show with a hands-on demo of a mission from the Dreadnought mission chain from Titans. It was great seeing familiar faces and new space pilots from all over Europe. Truly, this is one of our favorite events and we can’t wait for the next time we have something timely to show there.

[previewyoutube=DJlcuD6sr9o;full][/previewyoutube]
While we were at Gamescom, we met a bunch of incredible indies to give shoutouts to, many of whom were also from our Studio’s hometown, Hamburg! If you haven’t yet watched our ROCKFISH Shoutouts video, check it out! All these developers were excited to share their creations with gamers—you might just find your next favorite indie! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/4726157cbb6363c7e04529340b64df63342b3ed0.jpg[/img]
[i]Funny how we always seem to be placed right next to our friends at Egosoft![/i]

Meeting fans from Japan, China, and all over the world at Tokyo Game Show was an exciting time as well! We frequently join the German Games Pavilion at events to showcase some of the best games created in Germany to fans around the globe. If you ever hear of us at an event, please drop by to say hi. It’s always appreciated!

The team has been quiet about what we’ve been working on, but that’s going to change next year! As part of a new adventure, space pilots will return to Aethon, just one of the star systems coming in an all-new EVERSPACE 2 expansion launching in 2025. That’s just the tip of the asteroid, we don’t want to give too much away—Stay tuned for the full announcement, expansion title, and more info in the new year!

[previewyoutube=P2HY4RmXstg;full][/previewyoutube]

Also, that cool BOB shirt Garry was wearing on stream is available on the [url=https://store.ign.com/products/everspace-bob-t-shirt]IGN Store[/url]. The holidays are here, so treat yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/f316f92641156507490c7d346d0e684f8c698a65.jpg[/img]

We wish all you space pilots a happy and safe holiday season. See you in the new year!

Lee and the ROCKFISH Games team

notes.title: Combat & Crew: A New Cross Studio Bundle
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/ae4b4acc83b6ede4d2974086c9d8dbc5a802da05.jpg[/img]

It’s no secret that the ROCKFISH Games team loves space games. From Freelancer to FTL, space games of all kinds inspire us to craft epic experiences for genre fans around the globe. 

Void Crew by Hutlihut Games caught our eye early on as a cool way to enjoy a different kind of space game experience where players work together to survive. Running from one situation to the next, whether it’s piloting the ship, blasting away at enemies using the ship’s guns, making emergency repairs, or being launched out of an airlock to scavenge resources off a derelict ship, crew members get to experience different kinds of encounters every time they play. With our roguelike roots, we love this kind of thing! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/215e524a9a5569eeb92eeca069feb156c96b8f94.jpg[/img]

Void Crew is a Chaotic, Co-op Roguelite game for 1 to 4 players: Outfit your spaceship and crew for thrilling quests, brave fierce enemies in Space Battles... and try not to panic!

It’s a great concept that the Hutlihut team has pulled off magnificently after a busy time in Early Access. We hope to see them continue to succeed! 

Our two studios have crewed up with a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48806/Combat_and_Crew_Bundle__EVERSPACE_2__Void_Crew/]new Steam bundle[/url] that includes a discount to help fans of our respective series find new space games to try. We hope our fans will enjoy their frantic co-op gameplay while theirs can dive into the vast explorable star systems of Cluster 34! A special shout out to our friends at Focus Entertainment for helping to set this up. 

We’ll see all you EVERSPACE fans later today with our yearly recap and a little tease of what we’ve been working on.

Lee and your ROCKFISH Games team

notes.title: Update 1.3.43094 is now live - Post-Titans Patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/4daf489f331c34cf6ec15e7302e24795fb6a4a73.png[/img]

Greetings, pilots!

Not too long ago, we released [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873460/EVERSPACE_2__Titans/]EVERSPACE 2: Titans[/url], our first story and gameplay DLC for our semi-open world, space shooter RPG. Since then, we’ve seen tens of thousands of pilots challenge the Dreadnought and explore Leviathans. Many pilots have been very vocal about their new favorite weapons (Inferno, Inferno, and more Inferno) and characters (hello to all you Maya stans). It’s been awesome to see so many happy space pilots out there!

When we introduced these two massive experiences, we also brought in a few little bugs. Today, we’re releasing update 1.3.43094, a patch containing more optimizations, tweaks, and bug fixes reported and requested by the community. Thank you to everyone who reached out to let us know if something was wrong, unbalanced, or particularly liked! 

[b]Changelog 1.3.43094[/b]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed that "Find and destroy all eggs & parasites" leviathan task could not be completed if eggs were already destroyed or parasites had hatched before task became active
[*] Fixed that new Titans catalyst blueprints did not drop from high-risk areas
[*] Fixed that the Dreadnought's beam laser could sometimes fire for an unlimited amount of time
[*] Fixed that the Missile Defense System device also counted in dreadnought task which requires the player to destroy missiles
[*] Fixed that Leviathan Pearls could spawn at BRI before even obtaining the first pearl in a Leviathan
[*] Improved game over screen display when Dreadnought kills the player with one of its one-shot missiles.
[*] Fixed that the right-hand side UI progress bar did not update while HUD was disabled
[*] Fixed different issues with HUD and task-specific elements when a Dreadnought event was failed
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause the “failed” dialogue to play when dropping a decoy at the Dreadnought's targeting array
[*] Fixed that attacking outlaw bosses did not fail the mission during "Going Once, Going Twice…"
[*] Handle an edge case that could cause problems with Leviathan mission if Titans DLC was just installed and a save was loaded in which the player was docked at Prescott Starbase
[*] Fixed a potential crash with Tides of the Siren's Sea final damage bonus
[*] Fixed that alarm drone scanning sound sometimes persisted after destruction of a drone
[*] Fixed that teleporting into a wall while grabbing objects could lead to the grabbed object being stuck inside the wall
[*] Fixed that Leviathan Jellyfish destroyed by Flak projectiles did not decrease agitation
[*] Fixed that pickups could become broken when cargo was nearly full and Dismantler catalyst was equipped
[*] Fixed that shooting own sticky turrets counted as kills for Evolution catalyst
[*] Reduced Twin Surge camera shake in 1st person view to prevent camera from going behind the seat
[*] Fixed reflection of negative damage/healing with the Reflect perk/condition to enemies
[*] Fixed that EMP Mines did not target Ancient Wardens
[*] Fixed Preparation perk resetting when collecting orbs or flying through mending spores
[*] Fixed that shield reset when docking while Tides of Siren’s Sea 3 set bonus was active
[*] Fixed problems with Perfect Hatred and The Scourge when they were not active while entering a location
[*] Fixed Ancient lens sometimes starting to rotate wildly while aiming
[*] Fixed an issue which caused NPCs to jump out immediately at the beginning of a location (fixes problem with missing Ancient Wardens in “Bodyguard” Rift Boss modifier)
[*] Fixed ability to "roll away" attribute amplification by the catalyst when re-rolling attributes
[*] Fixed a rare blocker in “The Emissary” mission in which it was somehow possible to undock from the corvette without the game noticing
[*] Fixed an issue that could prevent the start of a follow-up Dreadnought mission
[*] Fixed a rare case in which it was impossible to finish “Risky Business” mission
[*] Fixed that players were able leave mission are during “Demolition Bot” mission
[*] Fixed that Lumen artifacts were caused by ship exhaust effects
[*] Fixed wrong size of Inferno muzzle effect

[*] [Windows: Steam, GOG, WinGDK] Fixed that XeSS version was misreported as 1.4 (Unreal Engine Plugin version), actual version (XeSS library version) is 1.3.0

With this patch released, the majority of our team is turning their attention to what comes next. We’ll have more to share in the new year, but for now, tune into our bi-weekly streams for fun, Dev Q&A, community recognition, and behind-the-scenes deep dives.

notes.title: EVERSPACE 2: Titans is Available Now!
notes.content:
Greetings, Pilots!

Big news! EVERSPACE 2: Titans is now live on all platforms, so it’s time to pick up your copy today! While it downloads, read on to check out our launch trailer and find out what’s included in today’s EVERSPACE 2 patch.

[previewyoutube=MoOaS6oqMGY;full][/previewyoutube]

If you missed our big announcement at Gamescom, Titans is our first story and gameplay DLC for EVERSPACE 2. This expansion adds two new questlines that take place mid-game, but don’t worry; this isn’t missable content—pilots with late-game saves can simply load EVERSPACE 2 and be able to enjoy the new quests scaled to their level. 

The new adventures surrounding the fearsome Dreadnought and mysterious Leviathan bring new gear alongside repeatable experiences unlocked by completing each story. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/bd230efbc6bb7b7e79c61df632f891662586c3ac.png[/img]

EVERSPACE 2 pilots have seen the bones of these ancient creatures planet-side and in deep orbit. Now, they must chase down the rumors of a living leviathan. The Redeemers have plans for these creatures—pilot deep inside leviathans to battle new biological and mechanical enemies as you work to save these gargantuan beasts. No two adventures within will be the same! Discover parasites, traps, puzzles, and new resources while exploring a leviathan’s procedurally generated insides.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35665597/29bfdb4f786321016869b83002bebdd2996775e1.png[/img]

The scars of the Okkar-Colonial War run deep in Cluster 34. The Dreadnought Minokawa was hijacked while enroute for decommissioning—a warship this mighty can turn the tides of power towards whoever holds it. Track and defeat this titanic threat, but be prepared for the biggest battles in the EVERSPACE series so far. Test your skills and ship loadout in gigantic, multi-stage boss fights designed to push pilots to their limits.

Players of the first EVERSPACE will see a number of fan favorite weapons return to the series in this DLC including Cluster Mines, Plasma Thrower, and the Goo Gun. Titans also adds a variety of new gear, item sets, consumables, and catalysts, as well as many blueprints to find and craft. 

If you missed our earlier blog, check out a quick look at some of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1128920/view/6468946777870831148]new items[/url] you’ll find in EVERSPACE 2: Titans.

We’ve also released an update filled with tweaks and fixes for a number of issues including Maddocks' freighter durability in “Smoke & Mirrors” and optimization. AMD fans can enjoy the latest scaling technology with FSR 3.1.0 enabled. 

Read on for the full list of patch notes in today’s update.

[b]Changelog: 1.3.42909 Titans DLC[/b]

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Titans DLC button added to main menu screen
[*] [Windows: Steam, GOG, Microsoft Store] Upscaling plugins: Updated DLSS to version 3.7.2, FSR to version 3.1.0, XeSS to version 1.4.7. NOTE (Steam, GOG): FSR3 Frame Interpolation is incompatible with Reflex Latency Reduction and DLSS-FG and requires restarting the game to fully enable.
[*] [Windows: Steam] Integration with Steam Game Recording: Emit game state to timeline with location names and events on player death, boss defeated, achievement-level challenge, and more. NOTE: As of 2024/09/11 this Steam feature is still in beta, requiring the beta client.
[/list]
[b]Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*] G&B Freighters now come with two different container variants
[*] Slightly decreased Redeemer Crusader damage reduction when its front shield is not up
[*] Made Maddocks' freighter stronger during “Smoke & Mirrors”
[*] Always enforce full forward throttle while Energized Boost is active
[*] Increased health of friendly Ancient Warden spawned by Domination blessing in rifts
[*] Adjusted value rounding of chaos catalyst
[*] Quantum Mend rift boss: Increased teleport interval and decreased maximum teleport range
[*] Disallowed install of Flawless catalyst when legendary item had no legendary attributes
[*] Mac: Allow use of Cmd-key for item multi-select in inventory
[*] UI: Improved equip target slot logic for weapons and consumables when crafted via crafting tab
[*] UI: Added ‘show on map’-action for mineable resources in crafting inventory
[*] UI: Removed redundant catalyst tag in catalyst selection
[*] [PS5, Windows: Steam, GOG, Microsoft Store] DualSense™: Boost with adaptive trigger now also applies to fast forward in supralight (challenge unlock)
[*] [Windows: Steam] Supporter Pack should now work DRM-free
[*] Integrated community suggestions for translation improvements from [url=https://crowdin.com/project/everspace2]Crowdin[/url]
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed that mission log did not regard "Show HUD elements in corners" setting for wide aspect ratios
[*] Prevent Vengeance mutator detonator drones from exploding when Explosive Death mutator is active
[*] Fixed time extender behavior at the end of rifts and when player ship explodes
[*] Fixed that Preparation perk buff stack was reset when picking up energy orbs
[*] Fixed that "Close Call" perk was reset between rift stages
[*] Fixed that Detonator Drone damage in rifts was not correctly scaled
[*] Fixed that the inventory could be opened after opening a rift via the spatial bypass
[*] Fixed that shield and armor bars were swapped in cockpit
[*] Fixed that when selecting resolution, scrolling was not possible if there were too many resolution options to fit the screen
[*] Fixed that Energized Boost wasn’t working as intended when energy was depleted
[*] Fixed that armor component's ignore damage chance would also sometimes ignore healing
[*] Fixed that ULT could sometimes not be triggered if ULT energy was regenerated too fast
[*] Fixed that some Catalyst affected the Sentinels ultimate static overload
[*] Fixed that acid pouches could not be detached at high frame rates (130fps+)
[*] Fixed that previous weapon was not re-selected after stopping Sentinel ULT
[*] Fixed that player attributes were not correctly updated when installing a catalyst on a module and then unequipping the module
[*] Fixed “Ritual” exploit, where cool down could be skipped by switching weapons back and forth before the end of the burst
[*] Fixed that quantum tether in combination with grim reaper or executioner could insta-kill tethered enemies in certain cases
[*] Fixed that damage limiter consumable did nothing in most situations
[*] Fixed: Selecting a consumable or device with EquipmentWheel could trigger another action bound to the same directional input used to select
[*] Fixed that it was possible to have two “Ramen Delivery” jobs active at the same time by not allowing these as dynamic job offers anymore that can be accepted during supralight via map
[*] Fixed rerolling of mine launcher item attributes
[*] Fixed that secure hold cargo unit trait increased received damage instead of reducing it
[*] Fixed Detoxification mission could end up being stuck due to auto-saving
[*] Fixed Clockwork having no collision in “Same Day Delivery” mission
[*] UI: Fixed a crash when crafting missing components for legendary catalyst
[*] UI: Fixed wrong crafting state icon for consumable blueprints in some cases
[*] UI: Loot screen - Fixed that inventory scrolling wasn't available when picking up big amounts of loot at once
[*] UI: Loot screen - Fixed that inventory item count was wrong or misleading in some cases
[*] UI: Loot screen - Changed headline to 'No Capacity' in case screen was shown due to insufficient cargo space
[*] UI: Crafting result screen - Fixed broken equip action in some rare cases
[*] UI: Item stat card - Fixed that hero attributes and device description background wasn't scrolling along
[*] UI: Item stat card - Fixed that scrolling indicators might have been displayed accidentally in some cases
[*] UI: Item stat card - Fixed some smaller overlap and obstruction issues while scrolling
[*] UI: Item stat card - Fixed that set item background could disappear after viewing device item stat cards
[*] UI: Item stat card - Fixed minor text clipping issue in device item stat card
[*] UI: Fixed rare focus loss after crafting and dismantling an item
[*] UI: Fixed rare bug that could lead to stuck (uncompleted) perks even though all of their requirements were met
[*] UI: Crafting catalysts - Fixed that legendary border could be accidentally displayed for unlocked blueprints in rare cases
[*] UI: Fixed a bug that could remove the option to buy items from a shop after selling ship(s) from the homebase in rare cases
[*] UI: Fixed potential focus loss after manually deleting the last savegame
[*] UI: Fixed misleading action button caption when storing multiple items on homebase
[*] UI: Fixed a bug that prevented equipping of crafted consumables in some cases
[*] [PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Microsoft Store] Stop Apocalypse countdown in rifts when boss has been destroyed
[*] [PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Microsoft Store] Fixed not being able to let go of portable objects in some cases
[/list]
The entire ROCKFISH Games team is excited to see pilots around the world take on the new massive challenges introduced in Titans. We’ve got more exciting expansion content in the works and will share more when the time is right. For now, good luck battling the Dreadnought and exploring the insides of leviathans!

Lee and your ROCKFISH Games Team
